The interpretation's caveats (0.9187 is distinct from A's claimed >=0.99 native-grid check; reject unbiased-stacking language; P2 lesion F1 opposes Dice-only promotion) are therefore correct. Sprint12b (T, 7ad63a2b...): primary +0.008 (+0.000 to +0.015), 15 predictions/patient (5x3), positive 5/5, lesion F1 +0.009 (-0.004 to +0.026) [L814-820]; MTT +0.014 (+0.006,+0.021) [L842]; 47 exploratory contrasts; the "printed +0.000 / MET does not verify strict positivity on the same exposed patients" caveat is accurate. Cost arithmetic (R, 0175d1c5...): A100-80GB $2.4984/h; composite $2.4984+8*0.04716+64*0.007992=$3.387168/h and +12/180=$4.50288/h; 35.69*250*5/3600=12.39 h; all labeled estimates versus the single smoke-derived measurement, with no spending authorized and no assumed cap headroom.

Code/spec and call-site wiring. The three carried code findings are genuinely resolved in the actual executable, confirmed in the diff (a67bb73a...) and patch (9d9a7d64..., safe-notebook-patch/v1 with correct original 73f656d5... and view 04aeab89...). F-VERDICT-FOLD-MEMBERSHIP: validate_full_folds enforces set(held)==range(5), exactly 99 unique members, shuffle 101 and one-to-one outer joins; N_ALL=99 hardcoded; FROZEN_PARTITIONS_SHA256=None raises an item4 hold; wired into arm_table, other, pair and the PRIMARY verdict path. F-MAGNITUDE-RATIO-GATE: the ratio/inf gate is removed and verdict_from_intervals (conjunctive, both lower bounds>0 for better, both upper<0 for worse, else no clear difference, refusing malformed intervals) is called from primary reporting; three distinct fingerprints/run_dirs required; training remains unseeded with train_seed as a pairing label only. F-COVERAGE-PROXY: coverage_support(values,brain,coverage=None) returns brain & isfinite (& coverage when supplied) with coverage_known metadata; prep_channel raises an item4 hold for perfusion kinds when coverage is unknown, retains valid zeros, and holds on empty/constant support; pnorm_levels raises. These are the notebook's real functions; the harness extracts actual AST definitions with no top-level loading/training/driver, so the synthetic checks exercise real helpers rather than stubs.

Receipts and provenance. Provenance (2c2a241b...) reports original_unchanged=true, compile PASS for 11 code cells, real_data_execution=false, scientific_approval=false, and the membership input externalized (count 1) and not available to the synthetic tests. Isolation receipt: ISOLATED, exit 0, 1.68 s synthetic elapsed, no network/credentials/patient mounts, four passing groups (fold completeness 99 rows/5 folds/7 negatives; conjunctive verdict rule, no ratio, training_variance_estimated=false; coverage handling; six preserved lesion fixtures). The interpretation correctly states a passing synthetic receipt does not prove full pipeline execution.

Privacy/provenance. validation_result (b2485e2d...) reports VALID, SAVED_EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_ONLY, execution_performed=false, scientific_acceptance=false, registry 67fd16e5... matching the spec and navigation index 629f3dc8...; per_patient_material=[] with secret and locked-ID scans PASS. G (97f0dce4...) confirms 13A is operator-run r4 aggregates with executed code absent, 13B unexecuted, and item2 withholds the five per-patient sources; the interpretation's "patient-level files used: none" is consistent. The omitted EXCLUDED membership literal (cells/4 bytes 2090:2120) was never supplied or reconstructed. The 25 final-evaluation / 24 reserve lock is preserved.

Finding status and decision. Both finding records are CLOSED by the independent APPROVE at review-3 (2bce3d6d...), findings=[]; the original REVISE judgments are preserved and the spec's stale "open" wording is correctly updated to current closed status without self-closure by the author. F-SELF-REVIEW-NOT-OPPOSING's execution portions are correctly retained in carried-conditions.json as item4 preconditions (opposing-family review of the full run, baseline/environment/RNG receipts, coverage provenance, smoke/recovery, measured timing/fit/capacity, authenticated membership pin, dollar budget), which the governing task says remain item4 preconditions and are not blockers solely for being unexecuted. The next decision is proposed_action_type=stop with blocker_ids=[] (no open blocker exists), charter-anchored to follow-up infarct-tissue prediction; it is a stop for operator review, not a procedural review/reconciliation. The 150-word summary states the question, the MODIFY answer, key numbers (45.5-62.7 GPU h, ~$154-282 screen vs ~$327-678 all-arm, P2 +0.028 Dice / -0.030 lesion F1) and the main caveats (estimates not measured; same 99 exposed patients; full execution untested) without procedural boilerplate.

All eight plan questions are answered, the Sprint12b overlap is flagged with the correct same-exposed-patients qualification, scope is challenged (reject all-arm commitment; defer multiwin/L/pnormct; reject unbiased-stacking and L-size-causal framing), every option is costed with explicit rates, overhead, uncertainty and separately-counted scientific model-call scenarios distinguished from measured runtime, and the reserved-cohort/exploratory limitations are preserved. No defect was found in the revised code, synthetic tests, numeric claims, cost arithmetic, privacy posture, or decision form. Because there are no unresolved findings, APPROVE (which requires findings=[]) is carried by the empty findings set, not by this rationale.
